definitions.explanation: A wind blowing in the same direction one is traveling, making progress easier. Originally a nautical and aviation term.
Figuratively, circumstances that support progress or success. Often used in the expression {順風満帆|じゅんぷうまんぱん}.

examples.japanese: {順風|じゅんぷう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The ship moves forward with a tailwind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{順風|じゅんぷう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The plane arrived earlier than scheduled thanks to a tailwind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{順風|じゅんぷう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{帆船|はんせん}→帆船：22530_hansen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ぐんぐん→ぐんぐん：06177_gungun⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Riding a strong tailwind, the sailing ship surged forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{順風|じゅんぷう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}っている→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: The business is sailing with the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャリア→キャリア：10821_kyaria⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{順風満帆|じゅんぷうまんぱん}だ。
{順風|じゅんぷう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦{油断|ゆだん}して→油断する：25389_yudansuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not let your guard down precisely when things are going well.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (favorable, following) and {風|ぷう} (wind). The figurative sense (smooth sailing) is more common in everyday usage than the literal nautical meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順風満帆|じゅんぷうまんぱん} — smooth sailing (literally 'favorable wind, full sails'); a very common four-character idiom
- {順風|じゅんぷう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ — to ride a favorable wind; to have things going well

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追|お}い{風|かぜ}→追い風：14352_oikaze⟧: tailwind — more commonly used for the literal wind meaning in modern Japanese
- ⟦{向|む}かい{風|かぜ}→向かい風：16322_mukaikaze⟧: headwind — the opposite, both literally and figuratively
- ⟦{逆風|ぎゃくふう}→逆風：14368_gyakufuu⟧: adverse wind, headwind — the formal antonym of {順風|じゅんぷう}
